title: At the Restaurant
context: Kamu memesan makan malam di restoran untuk dua orang.

keyPhrases.phrase: Could I get the bill, please?

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Good evening. Do you have a reservation?
lines.translation: Selamat malam. Apakah Anda punya reservasi?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Yes, under the name Rahman, for two.
lines.translation: Ya, atas nama Rahman, untuk dua orang.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Perfect. Right this way. Here are your menus.
lines.translation: Baik. Silakan lewat sini. Ini menunya.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Thank you. Could you recommend something?
lines.translation: Terima kasih. Bisa rekomendasikan sesuatu?

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: The grilled salmon is very popular tonight.
lines.translation: Salmon panggang sangat populer malam ini.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: That sounds great. I'll have the salmon, please.
lines.translation: Kedengarannya enak. Saya pesan salmonnya.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Excellent choice. Anything to drink?
lines.translation: Pilihan bagus. Ada minuman?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Just sparkling water, thanks.
lines.translation: Air soda saja, terima kasih.

title: Job Interview
context: Wawancara kerja untuk posisi frontend developer.

keyPhrases.phrase: Do you have any questions for us?

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Thanks for coming in. Could you tell me a bit about yourself?
lines.translation: Terima kasih sudah datang. Bisa ceritakan sedikit tentang diri Anda?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Of course. I've been building web interfaces for four years, mostly with React and TypeScript.
lines.translation: Tentu. Saya sudah membangun antarmuka web selama empat tahun, kebanyakan dengan React dan TypeScript.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: What drew you to this role in particular?
lines.translation: Apa yang membuat Anda tertarik pada posisi ini?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I'm particularly interested in your focus on accessibility. That's something I've pushed for in my current team.
lines.translation: Saya sangat tertarik pada fokus Anda terhadap aksesibilitas. Itu hal yang saya perjuangkan di tim saya sekarang.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Can you give me an example of a difficult technical decision you made?
lines.translation: Bisa beri contoh keputusan teknis sulit yang pernah Anda ambil?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We had to choose between rewriting our state layer or patching it. I argued for the rewrite and we shipped it in six weeks.
lines.translation: Kami harus memilih antara menulis ulang lapisan state atau menambalnya. Saya mengusulkan penulisan ulang dan kami merilisnya dalam enam minggu.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Great. Do you have any questions for us?
lines.translation: Bagus. Ada pertanyaan untuk kami?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Yes — how does the team decide what goes into a release?
lines.translation: Ya — bagaimana tim menentukan isi sebuah rilis?

title: Hotel Check-in
context: Kamu tiba di hotel dan melakukan check-in.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Good afternoon, welcome. How can I help you?
lines.translation: Selamat siang, selamat datang. Ada yang bisa saya bantu?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Hi, I have a reservation under Putri, for three nights.
lines.translation: Halo, saya punya reservasi atas nama Putri, untuk tiga malam.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Let me check. Yes, a deluxe room on the fifth floor. May I see your passport?
lines.translation: Saya cek dulu. Ya, kamar deluxe di lantai lima. Boleh lihat paspor Anda?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Here you are. Is breakfast included?
lines.translation: Ini paspornya. Apakah sarapan termasuk?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: It is, from six thirty to ten in the ground floor restaurant.
lines.translation: Termasuk, dari pukul 06.30 sampai 10.00 di restoran lantai dasar.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Great. And what time is check-out?
lines.translation: Bagus. Jam berapa check-out?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Twelve noon. Here's your key card — enjoy your stay.
lines.translation: Pukul 12 siang. Ini kartu kunci Anda — selamat menikmati.

title: Daily Stand-up
context: Melaporkan progres di rapat harian tim.

lines.speaker: Lead
lines.text: Morning everyone. Let's go around. What did you do yesterday?
lines.translation: Selamat pagi semua. Kita giliran. Kemarin mengerjakan apa?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Yesterday I finished the search filter and opened a pull request.
lines.translation: Kemarin saya menyelesaikan filter pencarian dan membuka pull request.

lines.speaker: Lead
lines.text: Nice. And today?
lines.translation: Bagus. Hari ini?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Today I'm picking up the export feature. I should finish it by Thursday.
lines.translation: Hari ini saya mengambil fitur ekspor. Harusnya selesai Kamis.

lines.speaker: Lead
lines.text: Any blockers?
lines.translation: Ada hambatan?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: One — I'm blocked on the API spec for the export format. Could you pair with me later?
lines.translation: Satu — saya terhambat spesifikasi API untuk format ekspor. Bisa kita kerjakan bersama nanti?

lines.speaker: Lead
lines.text: Sure, let's do it after lunch.
lines.translation: Tentu, kita lakukan setelah makan siang.
